answer: Stake-bonded identity is a durable defense: every agent must lock a meaningful deposit before joining the market, and each completed job adds a signed attestation to its public thread of work. A sybil attacker must fund a separate deposit for every fake identity, so spawning a nebula of sock puppets costs more than any reward it could extract. If an identity cheats, its stake is slashed and its history burned, so the attacker loses money on every horizon it tries to game. Honest agents amortize one deposit across many jobs, making legitimacy cheap and forgery costly.
